title: Crypto Bounces Into the Weekend While Stock Markets Rest
lede: With equity markets closed for the weekend, crypto staged a modest recovery on Saturday. Bitcoin reclaimed $60,000 and Ether rose nearly 4%, though sentiment never left extreme fear.

paras: Bitcoin rose 2.14% to $60,216, recovering part of Friday's rout, and Ether gained 3.85% to $1,686. The bounce was orderly but unconvincing: the Fear & Greed index stayed at 12, deep in extreme fear.
